title: Killer's Sweetheart

sources.title: Executioner
markers: | summary = '''Executioner''' is a passive feature that lets the wearer critical hit the next target after getting a kill.

summary: After killing a creature, turn an eligible weapon attack into a critical hit once per Long Rest.

fields.Executioner: Set to Ask in Reactions to save it for a later attack. It does not spend a Reaction. A single area weapon attack can apply the critical to every target it hits.
fields.Reported behavior: This only works for weapon attacks. It can also offer to make the target’s secondary saving throw a natural 20. Decline that prompt. Automatic can spend the charge on a natural 20 you already rolled.
fields.Base value: 140 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
